title: LLM-Driven Accessible Interface: A Model-Based Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated user interfaces against accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2, EN 301 549, ISO 24495-1), utilizing automated quality checkpoints (NLP metrics for readability, semantic fidelity, and factual consistency), and planning user-in-the-loop evaluations to assess trust, clarity, and modality effectiveness to prevent exclusionary or biased outputs against individuals with cognitive, visual, auditory, and motor impairments.
